Referral Note

I am referring Mr. Kessler, a 34-year-old elementary school teacher, for psychiatric evaluation of worsening anxiety and repetitive behaviors over the past two years, including frequent handwashing, often several minutes of scrubbing after touching doorknobs, desks, or shared office equipment. Symptoms are now affecting both his work and his home life. He has no previous psychiatric treatment. Medical history is limited to seasonal allergies, treated with loratadine as needed. Thank you for seeing him.

Behavioral Observations (on arrival)

Appearance: Appropriately groomed.

Behavior: Alert and cooperative. Brought his own pen to complete the intake forms.

Speech: Normal.

Mood / Affect: Mood "anxious." Affect congruent.

Thought / Perception: Thought process logical. Intrusive contamination thoughts without delusions. Denies hallucinations. Denies suicidal and homicidal ideation.

Cognition / Insight: Insight good; judgment intact.
